I couldn't find a DOI for that exact title. The closest match is Croft & Poole's 2008 article, [10.1515/THLI.2008.007](https://doi.org/10.1515/THLI.2008.007), which is titled "Inferring universals from grammatical variation: Multidimensional scaling for typological analysis," so it may not be the paper you mean. The team note's claim of a Linguistic Typology publication in the early 1990s doesn't fit, since that journal began in 1997, and I'd disregard it.
